title: magnate-cut timeline
description: Machine-readable clip table for the magnate-cut assembly engine. This is the M-HYBRID master-prompt clip table (Part 13) expressed as data the assembler can execute: an ordered visual timeline of provided clips + generated animations, joined by S-tier transitions, over a designed audio stack (music beds ducked under a provided VO + SFX + scored silence), mastered to spec.

palette_track.description: Part 0.5 accent lock — oxblood #7A160E (scandal/fall) or gold #C9A24B (wealth/rise). Never mix.

master_true_peak_dbtp.description: True-peak ceiling. Never above -1.0 (the #1 lesson from the 8-video audit: 7/8 were clipping over 0 dBTP).

grade.description: Shared look-block (master-prompt Part 15.4 continuity layer) applied to EVERY visual segment so independently-generated clips read as one film. This is the fix for the 'assembled clips' problem.

lut.description: Optional .cube LUT path (relative to project dir).

grain.description: Film grain strength 0-20 (continuous across cuts hides seams).

vo.description: The provided voice-over narration — the SPINE the whole edit syncs to. Voice always wins (master-prompt R0): no music swell or SFX hit lands ON a stressed word.

offset_s.description: Delay the VO start relative to t=0 (for a cold-open beat before narration).

music.description: Chapter-scope music beds (Part 10.1 / Part 18 List B). Rotate tonal families — never repeat a family in consecutive chapters. Ducked under VO. Drop to a scored vacuum on [SILENT] beats (leave a gap here).

duck_db.description: How far the bed ducks under VO (Part 10.1).

family.description: Tonal family for the rotation gate.

sfx.description: Timeline-absolute SFX events (Part 10.2 / Part 18 List A). Mirror the camera move / transition. Land in the GAPS around the voice, never on a stressed word. Prefer low booms/subs over bright whooshes.

at_s.description: Absolute timeline time of the sound's impact.

segments.description: Ordered visual timeline. Each segment is one provided clip OR one generated animation. The transition_out on a segment describes how it hands off to the NEXT segment.

type.description: clip = provided Omni/live-action footage; animation = generated here (HyperFrames/Remotion/Blender); transition = a pre-rendered bridge clip inserted between two shots (rare — usually use transition_out instead).

src.description: Path to the MP4 (relative to project dir).

out_s.description: Trim end within the source; null = to end.

grade.description: Apply the shared grade look-block to this segment.

overlay.description: Optional transparent Mode-A overlay (kinetic type / arrow / alert-wash) composited over this clip. Use a MOV with a real alpha channel — qtrle or ProRes 4444 (most reliable); VP9/WebM alpha is flaky across ffmpeg builds. Master-prompt Part 16. The assembler preserves the alpha through scaling.

chapter.description: Which narrative chapter this belongs to (for reporting/QC).

transition_out.description: How this segment hands to the next. Omit / null on the last segment.

type.description: hard_cut/dissolve/fade*/wipe*/smooth* are rendered natively by ffmpeg. whip_pan/dof_rack approximate natively. crash_zoom/fly_through are the MagnatesMedia signature — supply a pre-rendered HyperFrames bridge via `src` (built from templates/), spliced between the two shots.

dur_s.description: Transition duration. hard_cut≈0.04 (one frame). crash_zoom≈0.58 per 14.6.3.

src.description: For crash_zoom/fly_through: path to the pre-rendered HyperFrames bridge MP4 to splice in.
